## Summary

- Describe the user-visible or maintainer-visible change.
- Link the issue or discussion for substantial work (`Fixes #…` when appropriate).

## Scope and risk

- Affected subsystems:
- Security, migration, compatibility, or rollback considerations:

## Validation

- List the commands, tests, or manual checks you ran.
- If a relevant check was skipped, explain why.

## Proof

- Add focused screenshots, logs, API examples, or before/after notes when behavior changed.

## Checklist

- [ ] This PR is focused and does not include unrelated refactors.
- [ ] Tests or checks cover the changed behavior, or the reason they do not is documented above.
- [ ] Public docs were updated if setup, APIs, architecture, deployment, or user-visible behavior changed.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private data, or unsafe example values are included.
